_provenance: docs/64 §7b link-local XYZ wrench from RL-policy replay (flat=bentp2_fc gen21, rough=p2r_v2_fc teleport-protocol authority). Component-wise worst-of(flat,rough). Units N, N·m. M columns are CONSERVATIVE UPPER BOUNDS (moment reference-point bug, docs/64 §8i, overstated 11-57%); F columns are valid. Design rule (docs/62): structure = P99 x 1.25 for the primary case, peak = reference case only (single-frame impacts are covered by the layered stack, not by static sizing).

_rod_lc3_worst_frame.note: measured simultaneous rod forces at the two foot ball joints, CAD frame (docs/77 §7)

steel_4.6_fastener.note: ISO 4762 M4 class 4.6 found in CAD - low grade, upgrade to 8.8 recommended

_fastening.topology: ALL fasteners thread directly into tapped aluminium (6061-T6). NO nuts anywhere in this design - never model a nut face; the internal thread is the load path and the weak link.
_fastening.engagement_rule: steel screw into aluminium needs L_e >= 2xD (1.5xD marginal); the 1xD rule is for steel nuts/steel tapping and must NOT be used here.
_fastening.strip_model: F_strip = 0.6*pi*D*L_e * tau_y, tau_y = 0.577*276 = 159 MPa (6061-T6); usable preload = F_strip / 2.
_fastening.head_seating: preload / head bearing area <= ~0.9*sigma_y = 248 MPa (embedment); matters most for low-head 소두 screws.

measured_status_2026_08_15.grade_4.6_preload_vs_alu_thread: OK at every location (1.4 kN M4 vs 3.6-23.7 kN allowable)
measured_status_2026_08_15.grade_8.8_upgrade: 20 M4 locations at exactly 1.5xD (L_e 6.0 mm, RS04 hip_R flange <-> pelvis) would exceed the aluminium allowable (3.7 vs 3.6 kN) - deepen the tap to 8 mm, torque-limit, or fit thread inserts
measured_status_2026_08_15.head_seating_max: 164 MPa (M5) / 146 MPa (M4) / 126 MPa (low-head M3) at 8.8 preload - all below 248

_decisions_2026_08_16.boundary_conditions: hold a link only at REAL interfaces: screw seats bolting it to the neighbouring link/actuator AND the joint bearing faces. No arbitrary cut planes.
_decisions_2026_08_16.sf_criteria: measured P99 already contains impact content -> report SF>1, SF>1.5, SF>2; optimisation evaluated at the same three levels.
_decisions_2026_08_16.load_convention: fix the PROXIMAL (pelvis-side) interface; the DISTAL joint's measured wrench enters at the distal interface.
